title: Using a staff without losing the loot
target: How to use a R.E.P.O. staff deliberately, given that the antigravity, void and torque staffs each move an object in a different way.
version: 0.4.0, read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A heavy object that has to move
A route out of the room

steps.do: Decide how the object needs to move before picking a staff.
steps.because: the game ships three staffs as separate items rather than one with settings (ItemStaffZeroGravity)

steps.do: Reach for the antigravity staff when the problem is weight.
steps.because: it is an item in its own right with its own surfaces (Antigrav Staff_Albedo)

steps.do: Reach for the void staff when the problem is distance rather than weight.
steps.because: the void staff is a separate item from the antigravity one (ItemStaffVoid)

steps.do: Use torque when the object needs turning rather than lifting.
steps.because: the torque staff has an arrow of its own (Torque Staff-Arrow)

steps.do: Clear the route before you start moving something, not afterwards.
steps.because: every staff is still a carried item, so you have to walk the object out (ItemStaffTorque)

commonMistakes: Bringing one staff and hoping it covers every problem.
Lifting something before checking the doorway.
Treating a staff as a way of carrying more rather than of moving differently.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
